items.title: Navigation state remains unaddressable
items.observation: The URL still remains unchanged after navigation.
items.user_impact: A user still cannot share the current state.
evidence: Reproduced navigation from state one to state two.
items.cause: Internal state still has no address contract.
acceptance_checks: A copied URL opens the same state.
items.disposition_reason: The address now changes with the view and reloads into the same state.

fix_packet.change: Write the active view into the address bar and read it back on load.
fix_packet.rollback: Revert the routing commit; nothing else depends on it.

acceptance.summary: a colleague opens a copied URL and sees the same state

items.title: Copy-link enhancement is absorbed by the routing work
items.observation: Copy-link behavior is part of the new routing work order.
items.user_impact: The original sharing outcome remains represented.
evidence: AS-02 acceptance includes copying the current link.
items.cause: A broader item owns the complete solution.
acceptance_checks: AS-02 exposes a copyable current URL.
items.disposition_reason: Merged without deleting the original identity or decision.

items.title: Primary action remains immediately clear
items.user_impact: Users can still begin without instruction.
evidence: Primary task again started without hesitation.
items.cause: The hierarchy retains one primary action.

items.title: Routing needs a complete share contract
items.observation: The route lacks copy and history behavior as one contract.
items.user_impact: Sharing and browser history remain inconsistent.
evidence: Copy and back-forward tests both failed.
items.recommendation: Implement address, copy, and history together.
